Hey — we're about to launch the CloudLens pricing page publicly and I'm nervous we're going to get it wrong. I've read some internal notes that suggest our 'resource-hour' metric might be confusing, and we have no idea how other successful tools in this space have handled the 'I don't know what I'll pay' anxiety that comes with usage-based pricing.

Can you run a proper competitive analysis on this? The context is all in `projects/cloudlens/context/product-brief.md`. I want to understand how the best platforms in this space communicate complex, unfamiliar pricing models in a way that builds trust with developers — specifically: how do they explain the pricing unit, provide transparency, and handle uncertainty before purchase.

Please save the output as a file named `archie-pricing-page-research-{today's date}.md` — Priya and Dom will need to review it before we write any copy.
